note: Machine-readable routing key: asset x location x hazard x role -> named office with the governing section cited. Every rule traces to docs/research/nepal-slope-responsibility-map.md. Rules marked 'uncertain' carry a legal_gap - read them before relying on them. Not legal advice.

rules.office: Ward Committee under the Ward Chair; municipal executive (Mayor/Chair) above it
rules.legal_basis: LGOA 2074 s.12(2)(c)(23) 'Remove floods, landslides in the roads'; s.12(2)(c)(21)-(22); Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 8 item 11 read with LGOA 2074 s.11(1) and s.11(2)(ट)
rules.citation: Local Government Operation Act 2074, s.11-12 (enacted Nepali, FAOLEX NEP209136)
rules.notes: Ward road duties are defaults applying until the municipal executive prescribes otherwise. Internal branch names vary between municipalities.

rules.office: chaired by the Mayor/Chairperson of the municipality (max 15 members)
rules.legal_basis: DRRM Act 2074 s.17(2); DRRM Rules 2076 r.8
rules.citation: Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act 2074, s.17
rules.notes: Emergency clearance is the LDMC's; permanent repair is the road owner's.

rules.office: Road Division Office (सडक डिभिजन कार्यालय) at the named place, under a Federal Road Supervision and Monitoring Office; HQ Geo-Environment and Social Section
rules.legal_basis: Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 5 item 20 (national highways = federal); Public Road Act 2031; Road Board Act 2058
rules.citation: Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 5 item 20; Public Road Act 2031; Road Board Act 2058
rules.notes: Which Road Division owns a given segment requires the DoR road inventory (ssrn.dor.gov.np) - do NOT infer it from district boundaries.

rules.office: chaired by the Chief District Officer; secretariat = District Administration Office
rules.legal_basis: DRRM Act 2074 s.16(2) (SAR, EOC, relief, control movement of vehicles and people, requisition); s.18 (security agencies)
rules.notes: Conflating emergency clearance with permanent repair is the classic misroute.

rules.office: provincial road division / infrastructure development office
rules.legal_basis: Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 6 item 12 ('State highways' = provincial); Sch. 7 item 15 (physical infrastructures, concurrent)
rules.citation: Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 6 item 12, Sch. 7 item 15
rules.notes: Constitutional allocation verified; the seven provincial org charts were NOT verified.

rules.office: Mayor/Chair issues orders; Ward Chair is the first contact
rules.legal_basis: LGOA 2074 s.27(2) land-use standards on the basis of land-risk sensibility; s.39 inquiry and action; s.41 demolish structures and recover cost; DRRM Act 2074 s.16(2)(n)-(o) demolition and relocation
rules.legal_gap: No provision was found empowering a municipality to compel a private landowner to stabilise a bare slope. LGOA s.41 reaches buildings/structures only.

rules.institution: The asset owner (local level for basic school / health post)
rules.office: school management committee or health office, coordinated by the LDMC
rules.legal_basis: Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 8 items 8-9; Sch. 9 items 2-3; DRRM Act 2074 s.17(2)(e)
rules.citation: Constitution of Nepal 2072 Sch. 8 items 8-9; DRRM Act 2074 s.17(2)(e)
rules.notes: Routing depends on who owns the building, which the hazard alone cannot tell us.

rules.institution: Department of Water Induced Disaster Management (DWIDM), MoEWRI
rules.office: division and sub-division offices - river training, bank protection, check dams, landslide control
rules.legal_basis: Water Induced Disaster Management Policy 2062 (2005); LGOA 2074 s.11(2) disaster management item 3 (local dams, river and landslide control)
rules.citation: Water Induced Disaster Management Policy 2062; DWIDM Disaster Review 2013
rules.notes: DWIDM also does landslide/debris-flow control on national highway sections (Muglin-Narayanghat, Sindhuli-Bardibas). Supporting watershed/bioengineering actor: DSCWM. dwidm.gov.np and dscwm.gov.np were unreachable, so division boundaries are UNCERTAIN.

rules.institution: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM), MoEWRI
rules.office: national weather/hydrology warning; NDRRMA disseminates; DDMC/LDMC disseminate locally
rules.legal_basis: DRRM Act 2074 s.11(k) (national disaster information system); s.16(2)(u); DHM's published mandate
rules.citation: DRRM Act 2074 s.11(k), s.16(2)(u); DHM published mandate
rules.notes: No instrument naming a single authorised issuer of a landslide-SPECIFIC public warning was found. DRRM Act s.24(2)(a): a false alarm is punishable.

rules.office: Geoscience Division - Geo-hazard and Geo-environment Study Section; Engineering Geology Section
rules.legal_basis: DRRM Rules 2076 r.4(3)(a) (Expert Committee to identify disaster-risk areas on the basis of the geological condition of Nepal); DMG published mandates
rules.citation: DRRM Rules 2076 r.4(3)(a); DMG published section mandates
rules.notes: CRITICAL: there is NO statutory must-consult-DMG duty on a road division or municipality. DMG's published function is national/regional survey and mapping, not project certification. Cite DMG as an opinion source, never an authority of record.

rules.office: chaired by the Chief District Officer; secretariat = District Administration Office
rules.legal_basis: DRRM Act 2074 s.16; DRRM Rules 2076 r.6-r.7
rules.citation: DRRM Act 2074 s.16; DRRM Rules 2076 r.6-r.7
rules.notes: The CDO's performance contract gives the CDO overall authority for response preparedness and SAR at district level, so routing through the DDMC attaches the advisory to an officer whose own appraisal depends on it.

rules.office: chaired by the Mayor/Chairperson; may constitute ward/community committees
rules.legal_basis: DRRM Act 2074 s.17; s.17(2)(f); DRRM Rules 2076 r.8
rules.notes: Ward-level committees are CONTINGENT - the LDMC constitutes them - and OPML found only about 60% of local governments had one. Do not assume a ward committee exists.

rules.office: federal authority and secretariat to the National Council and Executive Committee
rules.notes: The National Relief Framework's 10 humanitarian clusters contain NO landslide or geology cluster, and district DPRP lead-agency tables have no landslide row. That absence is the gap this routing key fills.
